text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, a letter from a fan arrives for Rice Shower.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her expression slips from one of happiness to one of slight unease.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Sometimes, I get this idea in my head…

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: What if cheering for me brings my fans misfortune?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I don't want to think so negatively, but…

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
choice_data_list: Why don't you read the letter first?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
choice_data_list: Why don't you read the letter first?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: "I get so much courage from seeing you racing with all your might."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: "And when I see you smile, I always feel warm inside."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Racing with all my might… My smile…

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: …I see. I'm not doing anything special, but that still makes them happy.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Big Brother… I want to work even harder!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Big Sister… I want to work even harder!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I want to bring happiness to the people who support me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The clouds of doubt disappear from Rice Shower's eyes, replaced by a blazing light!
